headline: Farranac Board Recast; Mooring and Stlican Posts Change Hands
war_summary: Since the noon edition the front has been restless at three points. Farranac Coast's strategic board, which still carried a single Warden post among ten Colonial, is now wholly Colonial, the latest exchanges around Transient Valley and The Bone Haft arriving just before the afternoon cutoff. Mooring County, once showing eleven Warden posts to one Colonial, now stands nine to three after more action at Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut. Stlican Shelf has swung once more, now five Warden posts against four Colonial, with Fort Hoarfrost the busiest marker. Weathered Expanse holds at six Warden posts to three Colonial but still shows the war's heaviest casualty sheet, though no strategic post has changed since noon. Callahans Passage remains all-Warden with severe losses; Stonecradle stays one Warden to eight Colonial, quiet on the ownership wire after morning flurries. Fishermans Row, Linn Mercy, and Gutter are dormant. No winner has been declared.
